# Research Assistant
1. Research Assistants report directly to the Research Director.
2. Research Assistants report to the nearest scientist, after the Research Director.
3. Research Assistants should not interact with more dangerous artifacts and anomalies without supervision by an accompanying Scientist or the Research Director.
4. Research Assistants are recommended to call for a Scientist, Research Director, Nanotrasen Career Trainer (NCT) for assistance or guidance in their research projects.
